title: Portrait of Willem III, Prince of Orange, King of England and Stadtholder (Godfried Schalcken)
depicts: Oil painting, dark candlelit bust of King William III: long dark curled periwig, pale face looking at the viewer, lace cravat, blue Garter ribbon, ermine-lined mantle over polished steel armour; a tall burning candle at right lights the scene, signed lower left. Painted while he was King of England, within a few years of Savery's 1698 demonstration to him at Hampton Court. Face approx x 0.38-0.57, y 0.16-0.40; candle flame approx x 0.74-0.87, y 0.09-0.30.
